faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.desc: Detailed answers to the most common questions about choosing storage systems, load capacity, and warehouse rack installation.

q1.question: Do you provide free on-site warehouse surveys and 2D/3D layout drawings?
q1.answer: Yes, 100% free of charge. Right after receiving your request, our structural engineers will visit your facility within 24 hours (in Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, and surrounding provinces) to inspect floor conditions, clear height, and prepare optimized 2D/3D layouts simulating forklift traffic.

q2.question: How long does it take to manufacture and install a complete racking system?
q2.answer: For standard racking lines (medium duty, Selective with ready steel coils), delivery and installation take 3 - 5 business days. For large-scale turnkey warehouse projects (Heavy Duty, Drive-In, Mezzanine from 1,000m² - 10,000m²), production and full installation typically take 10 - 20 days with 100% on-time guarantee.

q3.question: How much load capacity can each racking level support?
q3.intro: We supply flexible load-bearing solutions from light storage to ultra-heavy industrial loads:
q3.bullet2Text: 200kg - 600kg per level (with ribbed steel decking or industrial plywood).
q3.bullet3Label: Heavy Duty Racks (Selective, Double Deep, Drive-In):
q3.outro: All structures are engineered with strict safety factors complying with JIS G3101 and FEM 10.2.02 standards.

q4.question: What is your warranty and periodic maintenance policy after installation?
q4.answer: All industrial racking systems carry a 3 to 5-year warranty covering load-bearing steel structures and powder coating. Every 6 months, our engineers inspect anchor bolts, beam deflection, and operational safety free of charge, backed by a 24-hour rapid technical support team.

q5.question: Does the warehouse floor need special specifications for heavy-duty pallet racks?
q5.answer: An ideal warehouse floor should be reinforced concrete grade M250 or higher, at least 150mm - 200mm thick, and level for safe forklift operation. During our on-site survey, engineers check floor flatness and specify appropriate baseplates and heavy-duty anchor bolts to distribute loads evenly.

q6.question: Can I order custom non-standard rack dimensions tailored to my goods?
q6.answer: Absolutely. As a direct manufacturer equipped with automated roll-forming and powder coating lines, we specialize in designing and fabricating custom racking matched to your exact pallet sizes, cartons, clear ceiling height, and forklift specifications.

q7.question: Do you offer dismantling, relocation, or expansion of existing rack systems?
q7.answer: Yes. We provide complete dismantling, packaging, transport, and re-installation services when your business relocates warehouses, along with all add-on components (beams, crossbars, pallet supports, upright guards, safety barriers) for height or area expansion.

q8.question: What is the contract signing process and payment schedule?
q8.answer: Once both parties approve the 2D/3D layout and detailed quotation, we sign a formal contract accompanied by CO/CQ quality certificates. A 30% - 50% deposit is paid upon signing, and the balance is settled after on-site load testing and final handover acceptance.
